a0.speaker: narration
a0.text: Route 58, 1987. The crew calls it the edge of the world, because the catering truck won't drive any further.

a.speaker: tommy
a.text: Ever notice nobody says 'cut' out here? Desert doesn't care when the scene ends.

b.speaker: cass
b.text: Tommy. Get out of the car.

c.speaker: tommy
c.text: Cassie, it's a stunt. Squibs, fire bars, camera tricks. We do the dangerous part so somebody else gets the close-up.

c1.speaker: cass
c1.text: The fire marshal left an hour ago.

c2.speaker: tommy
c2.text: He left because craft services ran out of donuts. The man has priorities.

c3.speaker: cass
c3.text: Harcourt's standing where the extinguishers are supposed to be. He won't look at me.

c4.speaker: tommy
c4.text: Harcourt doesn't look at anybody. That's why they put him on fire watch.

d.speaker: voice
d.text: Rolling. Speed. HOTSHOT, scene forty, take one.

e.speaker: tommy
e.text: Hey. If this goes wrong, tell Mom I finally got top billing.

g1.speaker: voice
g1.text: Keep the cameras rolling. That's the take.

g2.speaker: narration
g2.text: Somebody drops an extinguisher. It bounces on the asphalt. It's empty. It rings like a bell.
